title: An approval still moves the baseline of every must-change row it does not name
foundBy: user report (host): "Add the missing parts of SAC-056, item 3 and item 5", after the note on LGR-015 that its rule covers gated rows only
details:
A `must-change` row's `value` is the baseline its progress is measured from. The runner reports an axe row as `serious/critical nodes 3 (baseline 5, Δ-2)`, and any other row as changed from that baseline or unchanged. `--record` rewrites that baseline whenever a fresh measurement differs, and the per-row approval added for LGR-015 does not cover it. A bare `make record-fixtures APPROVE=<id> REASON=<text>` on an unchanged tree therefore rewrites LF-27, LF-28, LF-34, LF-37 and LF-42, whose axe counts grow with this ledger. The progress those rows had recorded then reads as zero, and nothing in the diff says why.

The same run also rewrites `meta.recordedAt` when no row changed, so a run that records nothing still leaves `viewer/fixtures/expectations.json` modified.

To reproduce, run `make record-fixtures APPROVE=x REASON=y` on a clean tree and read `git diff viewer/fixtures/expectations.json`.
